thread:
mia-marketing: Quick one for tomorrow's launch rehearsal — can runtime run a tiny 'density probe' to validate token-level latency under different batch sizes? Need outputs by 09:00 PT.

Specs: redwood-mini-8b fp16 and mini-8b-q4; 3 batch sizes (1,4,8), 30 requests total (10 per batch profile), no KV cache (coldstart baseline). Deliverables: per-request CSV with batch_size column, p50/p90/p99, and a heatmap showing first-token vs steady-state latency. Also include one logits snapshot for any p99 outlier.

ron-runtime: We can do that. Two quick Qs: do you want synthetic payloads or the rehearsal payload set? And traces for all p99s or sampled?

mia-marketing: Use rehearsal payloads (same as demo). Sample traces for p95+ and full traces for any p99s.

sabrina-ops: Pool note: gpu-dedicated-5 has a patch rollout 02:00-03:30 PT; recommend starting at 06:10 PT.

ron-runtime: Scheduling: cold baseline 06:10 PT (run_id=db-1839123468), will cap concurrency equal to batch size, produce latencies.csv, percentiles.png, heatmap.png, traces.tgz, logits_snapshots.tar.gz.

bench-bot: Job queued: db-1839123468 (est 11m).

bench-bot: db-1839123468 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/db-1839123468/densityprobe.tar.gz

mia-marketing: Downloaded. Saw a p99 in batch=8, req id req-017. Can you attach trace and logits and a short note?

ron-runtime: Included traces/req-017.json and snapshots/logits-req-017.npy.gz. Short note: p99 spike occurred during first-token decode on host gpu-dedicated-5 while host was servicing a brief driver reclaim — appears infra-related. Re-ran batch=8 on gpu-dedicated-6, no spike.

sabrina-ops: We'll mark gpu-dedicated-5 as noisy during the patch window; recommend demo use gpu-dedicated-6.

mia-marketing: Perfect. One-paragraph summary for rehearsal doc please (3 bullets).

ron-runtime: Posted summary: "Density probe (n=30) on redwood-mini-8b (fp16) + q4 fallback across batch sizes 1/4/8. Artifacts: per-request latencies with batch_size, percentile plots, coldstart vs steady-state heatmap, sampled traces, and logits snapshot for a batch=8 outlier. Observed isolated p99 tied to host driver reclaim on gpu-dedicated-5; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-6. Recommendation: reserve gpu-dedicated-6 for rehearsal."

mia-marketing: Great — thanks everyone :sparkles: Closing thread.
